required_source.completed_result_used: Theorem C exact ruled one-sheet coarea formula and two-dimensional product-projection cap
required_source.real_application: For isotropic rank-three q_R, P(q_R in I, q_R>=0)<=pi*sqrt(2)|I| and E[(eps-|q_R-y|)_+ 1_{q_R>=0}]<=pi*sqrt(2) eps^2.

newest_partner.localized_result: If an original-coordinate 3x3 principal block has all eigenvalue magnitudes at least s, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 128*2^(1/4)/s <153/s, with arbitrary outside couplings and rough cap-one marginals.

multi_marginal_ruled_stability.statement: For isotropic exact rank-three signature (+,+,-), ||r_f^+-r_g^+||_infinity <= 40 sum_j sqrt(||f_j-g_j||_1).
multi_marginal_ruled_stability.scope: arbitrary dimension and spectral-frame orientation, arbitrary cap-one product marginals, positive/one-sheet output side
multi_marginal_ruled_stability.proof: Original-coordinate telescoping; positive and negative marginal differences have cap one and mass delta_j/2; apply prior uniform ruled submass theorem to each sign.

majority_halfline_regularization.statement: For every rough cap-one product law in the isotropic ruled chamber, the positive-sheet measure has a canonical r_f^+ in C_0([0,infinity)) with 0<=r_f^+<=pi*sqrt(2).
majority_halfline_regularization.logic: Height is paid first by the e5 ruled interval theorem. Compact-smooth approximation plus the new Linfinity stability constructs continuity afterward, including at the cone vertex.

regular_blowup_extraction.statement: For every integer N there is a rational algebraically generic target A_N, strictly positive real-analytic Schwartz cap-one marginals, rational y_N, and canonical p_N in C_0 with p_N(y_N)>N, while kappa_3(A_N):=max_{|S|=3} min_{lambda in spec(A_SS)}|lambda| satisfies 0<kappa_3(A_N)<128*2^(1/4)/N<153/N.
regular_blowup_extraction.proof: Use countable rational bang-bang skeleton; Gaussian-smooth each source and use fixed-matrix output-density stability; then apply newest product-preserving localized physical-triple theorem to the best triple.

rough_ruled_bridge.statement: After outside conditioning on an invertible original-coordinate 3x3 block B, square completion is an original-coordinate translation; original-coordinate mollification preserves cap and independence; product L1 convergence gives total-variation convergence; restriction to the fixed conditional majority event and quadratic pushforward contract TV, so the smooth ruled interval constant passes unchanged.
rough_ruled_bridge.geometry: Exact coarea factor 1/2 and reciprocal non-arclength ruling speed 1/|v_theta| retained; no post-rotation independence.

regularity_ledger.absolute_continuity: qualitative local-coarea fact for nonconstant quadratic pushforwards of absolutely continuous joint laws; no universal height consequence
regularity_ledger.essential_boundedness: paid by interval domination before any continuity claim
regularity_ledger.continuity: downstream; in the ruled majority chamber obtained as a uniform limit of compact-smooth output densities
